payload.message: Reminder (set 2026-09-25 with Randall's approval): it is time to scope the alert-ledger outcome scorer. Background: the old recommendation outcome grader was retired 2026-09-25 because its feeders stopped 2026-08-29; its 2,967 grades stay frozen in data/state-history/recommendation-outcome-grades.jsonl. The successor scores alert events in state/finance/ledger/alert-events-v1.jsonl (started 2026-09-24) against later closes from the nightly Yahoo price snapshots (no new quote job), to calibrate funnel-v1 ranking weights, test the ATR20 band floor, and rate alert types. Steps: (1) count alert events and how many have at least 5 and 20 trading days of later closes; (2) if the sample is large enough, draft a short scorer design (grades, horizons, inputs, tests, where it runs) for Randall's approval; if not, say how many more weeks it needs. Review and planning only: no build, schedule, canon, alert, or authority change without Randall's approval. Report the result to Randall in plain English.
